objective: Clarify the product problem, goals, scope and success criteria, with a compact model-neutral brief and portable task instructions.
request_basis: 2026-09-06: user asks to clarify the problem, objectives and scope first so many small models, not only named model families, can read and follow. Documentation and harness onboarding only.
acceptance: Distinguish product vision, first vertical slice, current research work and the development harness; no model-family dependency.
Define users, problem, inputs/outputs, goals, scope/non-goals, success/failure, ownership, assumptions and unresolved decisions without inventing stakeholder approval.
Preserve GAP eligibility, safety hard gates, partial/comparison evidence semantics, quarantine, label limits and ASTRA-01; do not change plan or thresholds.
Provide a compact entry brief plus task-specific reading and a portable task template for repository or read-only chat use; do not promise every small model will succeed.
Document proposed comprehension probes and model capability limits, not fabricated model evaluation results.
